# MathJax 3.2.2

The pinned `tex-svg.js` combined bundle is distributed under the Apache 2.0 license in `LICENSE`.
Acquired from the published `mathjax@3.2.2` npm package through jsDelivr:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js

The browser loads this local copy on opening a model note or comparison. SVG output embeds glyphs and does not fetch web fonts. Only the bundled base, AMS and newcommand TeX packages are enabled; dynamic extension loading and external services are not used.

Upstream documentation:
- https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/hosting.html
- https://docs.mathjax.org/en/v3.2/web/typeset.html
